'''Amadaine 17 (June 25)'''

==Events==
* [[998 NE]] - [[Egwene]] meets [[Elayne]], [[Gawyn]], and [[Galad]] and sees [[Min]].
* [[998 NE]] - [[Rand]] reaches [[Cairhien]] and reunites with [[Thom]]. He recieves and declines invitations from three noble Houses. Rand and [[Loial]] are attacked by [[Trollocs]] and take refuge in the [[Illuminator|Iluminators]]' chapter house.
* [[999 NE]] - Min frees [[Siuan]] and [[Leane]] and they escape [[Tar Valon]] with [[Logain Ablar]].
* [[999 NE]] - Loial and [[Gaul]] close the [[Manetheren]] [[Waygate]].
